cards.audioText: Could you describe your work background?
cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-2
cards.audioTextZh: 你能否介绍一下自己的工作经历？
cards.referenceText: I am a student pilot at Jiutian Flight School, where I train on the DA-40. I have accumulated 100 flight hours and currently hold a private pilot licence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是九天航校的一名学员飞行员，使用 DA-40 训练。我已经积累 100 小时飞行时间，目前持有私用驾驶员执照。

cards.audioText: What is your current position?
cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-1
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前担任什么职位？
cards.referenceText: I am a student pilot and I am currently undergoing flight training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是一名学员飞行员，目前正在接受飞行训练。

cards.audioText: Do you have any international flights coming up?
cards.audioTextZh: 接下来你还有国际飞行任务么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. After taking this exam, I'm flying to Singapore tomorrow morning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有。考试结束后，明天我要飞新加坡。

cards.audioText: In your opinion, what are the challenges of working in a foreign airline?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你看来，在外航工作有哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: I think the biggest challenge lies in language and culture. Therefore, we need to improve our English.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为最大的挑战在于语言和文化这一方面。因此，我们需要提高自己的英语水平。

cards.audioText: Do you want to work in foreign airlines?
cards.audioTextZh: 你想在外航工作吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I do. I think working in foreign airlines not only pays better, but also let me experience different cultures. It's a very interesting thing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我想。我觉得在外航工作不仅收入更高，而且可以体验不同国家的文化。这是一件很有意思的事情。

cards.audioText: Where did you fly to on your last flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近一次飞行是去哪里？
cards.referenceText: My last flight was from Sydney to Beijing, and then I had two days off. / My last flight was from Guangzhou to Shanghai. Because I have to take the test today, so my leader arranged me to fly a short flight in order to get much time to prepare.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最近的飞行是从悉尼飞到北京，然后我有两天的休假。/ 我最近一次飞行是从广州到上海，因为我今天要参加考试，所以我的领导为我安排短程航班，这样我会有更多的时间来准备考试。

cards.audioText: What have you learnt being a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 成为飞行员后你学到了些什么？
cards.referenceText: The most important thing I have learnt is being calm under any emergency situation. I must believe in myself during emergency and make decisions timely and correctly. On the base of that, it could be possible to overcome difficulties.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我学到的最重要的事就是在遇到紧急情况时保持镇定。我必须相信自己，及时作出正确的决定。只有这样，才可以克服困难。

cards.audioText: Do you have flight tomorrow?
cards.audioTextZh: 你明天有航班要飞么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I'll fly to America.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有，我要飞美国。

cards.audioText: When did you start flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 你何时开始飞行的？
cards.referenceText: I started flying in 2004.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我从2004年开始飞行。

cards.audioText: Do you have any plan about your future?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对你的未来有什么计划吗？
cards.referenceText: Since I am a student pilot and I fly C172 now, so I hope I can become a qualified pilot and join Air China and fly B787 in the future.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因为我现在还是一名飞行学员，飞的是塞斯纳172，所以我希望变成合格的飞行员，在未来可以加入国航飞波音787。

cards.audioText: How many hours in total have you flown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前的飞行时间累计是多少？
cards.referenceText: I have flown more than 12000 hours.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的飞行时间超过1.2万小时。

cards.audioText: How many years have you worked as a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从事飞行员工作多少年了？
cards.referenceText: I have not worked as a professional pilot yet because I am still a student pilot. My aviation experience comes from flight training rather than employment. I plan to apply for a pilot position after I complete the required licences and training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我仍是一名飞行学员，因此还没有担任过职业飞行员。我的航空经历来自飞行训练，而不是受雇工作。完成规定的执照和训练后，我计划应聘飞行员职位。

cards.audioText: Have you ever operated an international flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否曾执行过国际航班？
cards.referenceText: No, I have not operated an international flight yet. My flight experience is mainly limited to domestic training flights, although I have studied international flight operations in theory. I hope to gain experience on international routes after becoming a professional pilot.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我还没有执行过国际航班。我的飞行经历主要是国内训练飞行，不过我在理论上学习过国际飞行运行。成为职业飞行员后，我希望能积累国际航线经验。

cards.audioText: How many flight hours have you accumulated in total?
cards.audioTextZh: 你总共积累了多少飞行小时？
cards.referenceText: I have accumulated about 15 flight hours in total. Most of that time was gained through dual instruction on the DA-40. I am continuing to build experience as I prepare for my first solo flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我累计飞行了大约 15 小时，其中大部分是在 DA-40 上进行的带飞训练。为了准备第一次单飞，我正在继续积累经验。

cards.audioText: What does your family think about your job?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家人怎样看待你的工作？
cards.referenceText: They are proud of me for being a pilot. They all support my job. Before each flight, they help me to pack my luggage, and after the flight they prepare delicious food for me. I know they worry about me but they have never complained.
cards.referenceTextZh: 他们为我的工作而骄傲。我的家人都支持我的工作。每次飞行任务之前，他们都帮我整理行李。飞行任务结束后，他们为我准备美食。我知道他们会担心我，但他们从不向我抱怨。

cards.audioText: Do you like your current job as a pilot? Don't you feel stressful?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢现在这份做飞行员的工作吗？你不觉得有压力吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I love this job. I believe that if we find something we love we'll never hate our jobs. Instead, we're paid to have fun. Sometimes I actually feel stressful, especially after a long international flight, but I can adjust myself from the high pressure quickly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢这份工作。我相信只要找到自己喜欢做的事就不会讨厌工作。相反，在享受乐趣的同时还有收入。有时候我的确感到有压力，特别是长途国际航班后，但我可以很快从高压下调整过来。

cards.audioText: How did you feel when you flew for the first time?
cards.audioTextZh: 你第一次飞行时感觉如何？
cards.referenceText: My first flight was unforgettable. I was very nervous when I entered into the real cockpit for the first time. My hands were trembling when holding the control column, and I felt a mind blank for more than ten seconds. Then my instructor guided me how to operate each step. When I became relaxed, everything seemed to become easier. I followed the instruction and successfully flew into the sky. I won't forget my first solo flight forever.
cards.referenceTextZh:
第一次飞行经历很难忘。第一次踏进真实的座舱时我非常紧张。握住操控杆时我的手在颤抖，大脑至少有超过十秒钟的空白。之后教练一步步地指导我如何操作。放松下来后，所有的操作都变得简单。我按照指令成功地操纵飞机飞上天
空。我永远都不会忘记第一次单独飞行的经历。

cards.audioText: When and where did you learn flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是何时开始，在哪里学习飞行的？
cards.referenceText: I learned flying in CAFUC in 2008. In the first two years in university, I studied basic flying theories and aviation English in Guanghan, Sichuan Province. In the third year, I had my primary flight training in Luoyang Branch, Henan Province.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我于2008年在中国民航飞行学院学习飞行。大学前两年，我在四川广汉学习飞行基本理论及航空英语。第三年，我在河南洛阳进行初级飞行训练。

cards.audioText: How to recover from the red-eye flight as a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为飞行员如何从红眼航班中恢复过来？
cards.referenceText: Actually, I've never flown the red-eye flight, or the pink or even purple flight, but I think exercising, eating a filling meal and enjoying a nice sleep before the flight will ensure our body in a good condition and make us recover from tiredness.
cards.referenceTextZh: 实际上我没有飞过红眼航班，也没飞过粉眼或紫眼航班，但是我认为飞行前适度运动，吃一顿饱饭，享受一个良好的睡眠，都将确保我们的身体在一个良好的状态并且能够从疲倦中恢复过来。

cards.audioText: What challenges will pilots meet in the near future?
cards.audioTextZh: 在不久的将来，飞行员将遇到怎样的挑战？
cards.referenceText: With the rapid development of modern technology, aircraft become more and more advanced/automatic/computerized, more and more systems will be controlled by intelligent computers, so pilots must learn more new ideas and technologies.
cards.referenceTextZh: 随着现代科技的迅速发展，飞机变得越来越先进/自动化/计算机化，越来越多的系统将由智能计算机控制，所以飞行员必须学习新观念和新技术。

cards.audioText: What are the most challenging parts of your job?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员工作中最具挑战性的部分是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Being a pilot is a challenging job. We must be responsible for the safety of all passengers on board, so it's risky and stressful. During flight, we have to be very focused and careful, and I often feel exhausted. Sometimes I suffer from jet lag, so I don't think it's good for my health. With the development of aviation
industry, pilots must learn new ideas and technologies to keep pace with the times, so learning knowledge is another big challenge for us.
cards.referenceTextZh:
做飞行员极具挑战性。我们必须对机舱内所有乘客的安全负责，所以这份工作充满了风险和压力。飞行中，我们必须非常专注、仔细，我经常会因此感觉疲惫。有时候我要承受时差，因此我认为做飞行员对我的健康不利。随着航天业的发
展，飞行员必须学习新观念和新技术，与时俱进，所以学习对我们来说是另一大挑战。

cards.audioText: Are you a captain or a first officer? Where are you based now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是机长还是副驾驶？你们公司的总部在哪里？
cards.referenceText: I'm a captain and we are based in Wuhan now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是机长。我们公司的总部目前在武汉。

cards.audioText: Who influenced you most in choosing this job?
cards.audioTextZh: 选择这个职业时谁对你的影响最大？
cards.referenceText: I think it was my father, he was a pilot and has retired now. He often told me many stories about flying when I was a little boy, since then I had great interest in flying and I had determined to be a pilot. / Nobody influenced me. I became a pilot by chance, and I feel everything happens naturally.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得是我的父亲，他曾是一名飞行员，现在已经退休了。在我小时候，他经常给我讲许多飞行中的故事，从那时起我就对飞行产生了极大的兴趣并决定要成为一名飞行员。/没人影响我。我偶然间成为了一名飞行员，我感觉所有事情都是自然而成的。

cards.audioText: How many hours in total have you flown/accumulated?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的飞行时间累计有多少？
cards.referenceText: I have flown more than 12000 hours. / I have flown 7000 hours totally. / I have accumulated 2500 flight hours. / I have flown single-engine aircraft C172 for 120 hours, and PA-44 for 50 hours.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的飞行时间超过1.2万小时。/ 我共飞行了7000小时。/ 我的飞行时间累计2500小时。/ 我驾驶C172型单引擎飞机共120小时，驾驶PA-44型飞机共50小时。

cards.audioText: Do you think the job of pilot is promising?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为做飞行员有前途吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. I think so. With the development of China's civil aviation industry, more and more people are traveling by plane, and more and more new aircraft are produced and purchased. Therefore, more pilots are needed in the near future, so I think the job is promising.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为有前途。随着中国民航业的发展，越来越多的人乘坐飞机旅行，飞机的生产量及购买量也越来越大。因此，在不久的将来，飞行员的需求量也将增大，所以我认为这份工作是有前途的。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages and disadvantages of being a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 做飞行员的优缺点分别是什么？
cards.referenceText: Speaking of advantages, first, I can get high salary and good benefits, especially when I become a captain. If I work hard, my family can have a better life. Second, I can fly to different places all around the world, where I can feel different cultures and taste kinds of delicious foods. Third, with the development of aviation industry, pilots can learn many new ideas and technologies. When it comes to disadvantages, first, the work as a pilot is much more stressful because we must be responsible for the safety of hundreds of passengers on board. Second, it's a pity that we don't have enough time to stay with our family and friends. Last, to become a qualified pilot requires more money and consumes longer time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 说到优点，第一，我可以得到高薪资和良好的福利，尤其是当上机长后。如果我努力工作，我的家人可以生活得更好；第二，我可以飞往世界各地，体验不同文化，品尝各色美食；第三，随着航空业的发展，飞行员可以学习许多新的理念和技术。说到缺点，第一，飞行员承受的压力很大，因为我们要保证机舱内上百名乘客的安全；第二，我们没有足够的时间陪家人朋友；最后，成为一名合格的飞行员需要投入更多的钱和时间。

cards.audioText: According to your experience, how can a student pilot become a qualified pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 根据你的经验，飞行学员如何才能成为合格的飞行员？
cards.referenceText:
A student pilot must have a certain period of ground school learning to grasp the
knowledge related to flight. Also he must have real flight practice to gain good flight skill. Until he has passed all the required exams, involving theoretic and technique, and has got certificate of each course, he can become a qualified pilot.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一名飞行学员必须在地面训练学校学习一段时间，掌握飞行相关知识。此外，他必须进行真正的飞行实践，以获得良好的飞行技巧。通过所有必需的理论及技术考试，每门课程都取得合格证后，就可以成为一名合格的飞行员。

cards.audioText: What is your career plan in the next few years?
cards.audioTextZh: 你未来几年的职业规划是什么？
cards.referenceText:
I am a co-pilot now. I will make great efforts to be a captain in the next few years.

I want to fly more international routes, so I will work hard to improve my oral English.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我现在是副驾驶员，在未来几年我会努力地成为一名机长。

我想飞更多的国际航线，因此我会努力学习，提高我的口语。

cards.audioText: Have you ever flown the international flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过国际航班吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, we used to fly the international flight, like the flights from Shanghai to Seoul, but during the outbreak of the COVID-19, our international flights have been slashed./No, I rarely fly the international flights, I often fly the domestic flights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我过去经常飞国际航班，像上海到首尔，但在疫情爆发期间，我们的国际航班量锐减。/没有，我很少飞国际航班，经常飞国内。

cards.audioText: How many hours have you flown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞行了多少小时了？
cards.referenceText: I have flown 200 hours.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我已经飞了200个小时了。

cards.audioText: Which flying stage are you in now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在飞行的哪个阶段？
cards.referenceText: I have just finished my commercial flight and obtained the commercial pilot license (CPL), I will continue my instrument flying next month.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我刚刚结束了商照飞行并且刚拿到了商照，下个月我开始飞仪表。

cards.audioText: Are you a student pilot or a first officer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是飞行学员还是副驾驶？
cards.referenceText: I'm a student pilot/first officer/a captain / a flight instructor /a ground instructor.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是飞行学员/副驾驶/机长/飞行教员/地面教员。

cards.audioText: How many flight hours in total do you have?
cards.audioTextZh: 你总共飞了多少小时？
cards.referenceText: I have flown about 200 hours.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞了大概200小时。

cards.audioText: Would you like to work for a foreign airline, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你愿意为外国航空公司工作吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I would consider working for a foreign airline. It would allow me to experience a different aviation culture and management system, improve my cross-cultural communication, and develop my professional skills.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我会考虑到外国航空公司工作。这样可以让我体验不同的航空文化和管理体系，提高跨文化沟通能力，并发展自己的专业技能。

cards.audioText: What has been the most unforgettable experience of your aviation career?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的航空职业生涯中最难忘的经历是什么？
cards.referenceText: My most unforgettable experience was my first solo flight last year. The sky was clear, visibility was acceptable, and the wind was calm. I felt nervous at first, but my instructor encouraged me, and I completed three traffic patterns safely.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最难忘的经历是去年的第一次单飞。当时天空晴朗，能见度可以接受，风也很小。起初我有些紧张，但教员鼓励了我，最后我安全完成了三个起落航线。

cards.audioText: What challenges might a pilot face when working for a foreign airline?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员为外国航空公司工作时可能面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: A pilot may face language barriers when communicating with colleagues and controllers. The pilot also has to adapt to different aviation regulations, operating procedures, cultural expectations, and working rhythms. Integrating into a new team can take time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员在与同事和管制员沟通时可能遇到语言障碍，还需要适应不同的航空法规、运行程序、文化习惯和工作节奏。融入一个新团队可能需要一些时间。

cards.audioText: What are your plans for your future aviation career?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对未来的航空职业生涯有什么规划？
cards.referenceText: I plan to obtain my commercial pilot licence and then join a reputable airline. I hope to build experience steadily, become a captain in the future, and contribute to safe flight operations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我计划先取得商用驾驶员执照，然后加入一家信誉良好的航空公司。我希望稳步积累经验，将来成为机长，并为飞行安全作出贡献。

cards.audioText: Why do you choose to be a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 你为什么选择成为一名飞行员？
cards.referenceText: Because I'm very proud to be a pilot. Being a pilot offers me a good opportunity to travel and to see the world. I have been to many places, Europe, America, Asia, and so on. I have met people of different backgrounds and have experienced their cultures. All these are valuable experience for me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 能成为一名飞行员我感到自豪。当飞行员提供给我一个环游世界的机会。我去过很多地方，欧洲、美洲、亚洲等。我遇到过许多不同背景的人，体验了他们的文化。这些经历对我来说都是很宝贵的。
